desc: Build DSU to compute component id for each vertex (1..N).
BFS/DFS to 2-color each component; collect sizes of color 0 and color 1 per component.
Build list of non-empty group sizes; let k = number of groups.
Compute `pairs = k*(k-1)//2 - M`; if `pairs` is odd print "Aoki", else print "Takahashi".
Wrap reading/writing in solve() and handle up to 2e5 efficiently (O(N+M) time, O(N) memory).
